title: My Mall is an Airport
content: Just found this sub, I have always identified the "mall" as more like an airport. Its often stressful, trying to get through all of the endless lounges and stores and long hallways. Very rarely do I make it all the way to an actual terminal but when I do, its usually a tiny room with only a few seats and the feeling that I still missed my flight is always there. The other reocurring one is a more like a theme park/festival, often oceanside.
